open.text: [softly] Meet Dan. He wins every meeting.

dan.text: [confidently] Trust me, I've done this for twenty years. Either we go all in on Atlas, or we're finished.

collapse.text: [gravely] It sounded convincing. Nobody checked the logic. [long pause] A year later, the company was gone.

pivot.text: [intensely] We have spell-check. We have grammar-check. [long pause] But nothing checks our logic.

intro.text: [confident] Meet Socrates: critical thinking, built into your browser. It flags weak arguments in what you read, and in what you write.

structure.text: [confident] It looks past the wording, to the structure of the argument.

d2.text: [suspenseful] When the reasoning slips, the exact words get tagged.

d3.text: Click the tag. [pause] Socrates won't tell you what to think. It asks the question that helps you decide.

d5a.text: [amused] And it checks your own replies too.

d5b.text: [amused] Subtle, it is not. [pause] Rethink it, and the flag clears.

d1.text: [calm] Open an article, and it reads along with you.

science.text: [confident] It catches the fallacies and biases behind bad decisions, [pause] and stays quiet when the reasoning holds.

privacy.text: [warmly] It reads only the article, email or reply in front of you, [pause] and it never tells you what to believe.

impact.text: [confident] Better arguments. Better decisions. [pause] Logic, not language.

outro.text: [warmly] Socrates. [pause] Critical thinking, built into your browser.
